purpose: Preserve actual experimental QoS_w labels; correct the methodological description transparently

components.interpretation: received DN-side throughput relative to the recorded per-direction offered objective; exact end-to-end UL/DL attribution not authenticated
stored downlink-delay summary; its historical aggregation is not an end-to-end tail-delay guarantee
RAN-side Avg us export; no milliseconds conversion in score construction
historical interval loss fraction; denominator and counter-reset handling require explicit verification

aggregation: Normalize the supplied weights by their sum, then sum component_score * normalized_weight

threshold.semantics: composite-score target; not a formal 5QI or individual-KPI service guarantee

normalization_caps_are: score saturation points, not standardized service budgets
historical_missing_value_behavior: NumPy arithmetic propagates NaNs; the notebook specifies no imputation or missing-row repair
future_validation_input_policy: Fail explicitly on missing or nonfinite inputs; do not impute, alter, or overwrite historical labels
zero_load: not measured; no new zero-load score or deployment claim is defined
not_guaranteed: actual measured QoS from a surrogate prediction alone
